summary: Recent updates to the WebRender component of Firefox have brought several enhancements aimed at improving graphics rendering performance and quality. Notably, developers have ensured that **embedded bitmap text can now be transformed properly, making text appear sharper and more dynamic**. Additionally, the framework has seen a shift towards a more streamlined architecture by moving various image handling features, like gradient keys and backdrop rendering, into the webrender_api. This not only simplifies the internal structure but also opens up new possibilities for visual effects. Other optimizations include improving how text shadows and gradients are processed, which contributes to a smoother and more visually appealing browsing experience.
